lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Posterior to the gill slits, high-luminance blobs are arranged in approximately five visible vertical columns. The spacing between centroids increases along the longitudinal axis, moving toward the posterior portion of the visible flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of subtly elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting horizontal spot rows to form a rectilinear grid pattern, most distinct in the region immediately posterior to the pectoral fin insertion.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient where the dorsal aspect is brightly illuminated and the ventral aspect of the ridge cast a distinct shadow.

other_distinctive_markers: A remora (Echeneidae) is visible swimming in the water column directly beneath the pectoral fin.
